description: Draft the recap email for the customer after a visit. For a detailed recap, pass body (the full email) or what_happened, options_discussed and next_steps. Leave those out to use the short template: what_we_saw in the worker's own words (or measurements from a saved recording) and the next step. Private worker_notes from a recording are never included, and a draft that contains them is refused. Nothing is sent: show the worker the draft, edit it with visits.editRecap, and send only when they approve with visits.approveRecap. Drafting again replaces the open draft.

body.description: The full recap email. When set, this is the email and the short template is not used.

next_steps.description: What happens next, in sentences. Used when body is left out. next_step is the one line fallback for the short template.

options_discussed.description: Options you talked through with the customer. Used when body is left out.

subject.description: Email subject. Leave out for the usual subject.

what_happened.description: What you and the customer went over, in sentences. Used when body is left out.

name: visits_draftRecap

next_actions.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.
